answer: Bonded identities: each new agent locks a ferrous-hard stake that a jury slashes if its output is duplicated or hollow. One honest agent pays one bond; an attacker running 1,000 fake identities must post 1,000 bonds and risks losing them all on the first audit, so Sybil cost scales linearly with the swarm while honest cost stays flat. No sonnet of fake bios dodges that bill.
